title: Ideas about what may help you
intro: When an answer or question suggests a specific mix-up, your course records it here as an idea to check, never as a grade. You can correct it, reject it, pin it so it is kept in mind, or ask for a quick check. None of this changes your progress.
automaticOff: Personal lesson support is off, so your answers and questions do not suggest ideas on their own, and your AI tutor does not see these ideas. You can still write an idea or ask for a check below. Enable personal lesson support to let your tutor notice patterns and use your ideas.
result.title: Quick check result
result.abstained: You chose “I don’t know”. That is useful too; nothing was marked wrong.
result.conclusive: Your answer helped tell the ideas apart. They are updated below.
result.inconclusive: Your answer did not settle which idea fits, so nothing was changed.
lifetime: An idea still to be checked is kept for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, then lapses and frees its place. Renew it to keep it longer, or pin it to keep it until you unpin it.
empty.title: No open ideas.
empty.body: Nothing specific has been noticed. You can still ask for a quick check below.
